specification.problem: Implement single-qubit POVMs (Trine, SIC, unambiguous state discrimination of two non-orthogonal states) with a single-photon polarisation qubit performing a quantum walk, using birefringent beam displacers for polarisation-dependent translation and wave-plates for polarisation changes.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Abstract-level reconstruction of the single-qubit POVM via quantum-walk (Naimark-style dilation into a walk position space); no experimental parameters, angles, or data are given. Equations are standard background or assumed finite instances.

symbols.domain: positive semidefinite 2x2 operators with sum_k E_k = I

symbols.meaning: Bloch vector of the k-th POVM direction

equations.label: POVM completeness and Born rule
equations.description: General POVM definition and outcome probabilities.
equations.justification: Standard definition of a generalised measurement (POVM).

equations.label: Trine POVM
equations.description: Three elements uniformly spaced in an equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere.
equations.abstract_quote: POVM elements uniformly distributed on an equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere
equations.justification: Abstract describes uniform equatorial distribution; explicit form is the standard trine.
assumptions: Three elements, equatorial plane taken as x-y plane

equations.label: SIC POVM
equations.description: Four elements forming a tetrahedron on the Bloch sphere.
equations.justification: Standard qubit SIC-POVM; the abstract only names it.

registers.name: pol
registers.role: Photon polarisation (H/V) encoding the system qubit

registers.name: pos
registers.size: small walk-position space (assumed a few modes, e.g. 3-4 spatial paths)
registers.role: Spatial mode set by beam displacers; serves as the Naimark ancilla and the outcome label

specification.initial_state: Single photon in a single input spatial mode with polarisation state rho (arbitrary input qubit) to be measured.

steps.description: Prepare the photon in the input spatial mode with polarisation state rho.
Apply wave-plates (assumed set to POVM-specific angles) to rotate polarisation before each displacement.
Apply a beam displacer to translate the photon path conditioned on polarisation, entangling pol with pos.
Repeat wave-plate and displacer layers for the assumed number of walk steps so the overall isometry maps rho into pos-labelled outcomes with amplitudes realising E_k.

specification.measurement: Detect the photon (e.g. single-photon detectors) in the output spatial modes after the final displacer, ignoring polarisation; the detected mode k labels POVM outcome k with probability p_k=Tr(rho E_k). Collect counts over many photons.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Normalise counts per output mode to estimated frequencies p_k and compare with Tr(rho E_k) for the trine, SIC and unambiguous-discrimination POVMs. For discrimination, interpret the inconclusive mode as the failure outcome and the other modes as conclusive state identifications.
assumptions: Standard POVM forms are used for the named measurements.
The walk acts as a Naimark-type isometry, with each output spatial mode corresponding to one POVM outcome.
Output spatial modes map one-to-one to POVM outcomes (the inconclusive outcome included for unambiguous discrimination).
Detection is by spatially resolved photon counting; the abstract does not specify the detectors.
Detection is by spatially resolved photon counting.
